article.story: AUBURN HILLS, Mich. -- — Brett White II had 18 points in Oakland's 113-47 win over Defiance on Saturday. White also contributed three steals for the Golden Grizzlies (1-3). Tuburu Niavalurua scored 17 points and added six rebounds and three steals. Brody Robinson shot 5 of 7 from the field and 7 of 10 from the free-throw line to finish with 17 points. Isaiah Meade-Moss led the way for the Yellow Jackets with 10 points, six rebounds and three steals. Carder Orr added nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
